crossRefs.note: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.
It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh…
There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.
You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant…
You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet…

parallels.note: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet…

translations.web: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.
translations.bsb: Place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet
translations.asv: And thou shalt lay them up in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.
